note: The OXE overview sheet's control frequency per family, read as raw CSV rows on the fetch date (V6 section 2). Keyed by the dataset's directory name with the _shardNNofMM suffix stripped, the name the gd6 layouts key its OXE entries by. dobbe is 3.75 Hz: the on-disk action_unify_spec.json says 30 and is not used (11.1 cm/s at 3.75 Hz against 88.7 at 30). kuka (201.7 cm/s) and language_table (108.4 cm/s) fail the speed check Hz x median step; that is a warning recorded in the manifest's control_hz_evidence, not a reason for NA (D2-A). info.json fps is 10 in every family because the converter's --fps default wrote it; it is not a clock.
